sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I'm Mike. Today is my tenth birthday. My parents [1] a birthday party for me. It is in a big restaurant. I invite(邀请) some of my friends to [2]. In the evening, my friends come to the restaurant. They [3] some presents (礼物) for me. I am [4] to see them. At the party, we do some interesting things. We play games. We [5] some good food and drink some juice. [6] are all happy at the party. My friends [7] a song to me. The name of the song is Happy Birthday to You. Then we eat a birthday [8]. The cake is from my [9]. She makes it for me.

After eating the birthday cake, my friends [10] me to open my presents. They are interested [11] the presents. All the presents are [12] and I really like them. I [13] "thank you" to my [14]. We have a good [15] at my birthday party. How happy we are!

questions.translation: 我的父母为我举办了一个生日派对。
questions.explanation: have a party意为“举办派对”，固定搭配。

questions.translation: 我邀请了一些朋友来（参加）。
questions.explanation: 此处用party指代派对活动或聚会场所，结合上下文应选party或home，但根据常识“invite friends to party/home”，结合选项此处B项party符合语境（注意：此处come to the party/home，选项B为party）。

questions.translation: 他们给我买了一些礼物。
questions.explanation: buy sth. for sb.意为“给某人买某物”。

questions.translation: 看到他们我很开心。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文“Today is my tenth birthday... I am happy to see them.”可知选happy。

questions.translation: 我们吃了一些美食，喝了一些果汁。
questions.explanation: eat some good food意为“吃美食”。

questions.translation: 我们在派对上都很开心。
questions.explanation: 前面提到“we do some interesting things”，因此主语用We。

questions.translation: 我的朋友们给我唱了一首歌。
questions.explanation: sing a song意为“唱歌”。

questions.translation: 然后我们吃了一个生日蛋糕。
questions.explanation: 上文提到吃生日蛋糕，故选cake。

questions.translation: 这个蛋糕来自我妈妈。她为我做的。
questions.explanation: 下文提到“She makes it for me”，故此处指妈妈(mother)。

questions.translation: 我的朋友们想让我打开我的礼物。
questions.explanation: want sb. to do sth.意为“想要某人做某事”。

questions.translation: 他们对这些礼物很感兴趣。
questions.explanation: be interested in意为“对……感兴趣”，固定搭配。

questions.translation: 所有的礼物都很好，我真的很喜欢它们。
questions.explanation: 根据“I really like them”可知礼物是好的(nice)。

questions.translation: 我对父母说“谢谢”。
questions.explanation: say sth. to sb.意为“对某人说某事”。

questions.translation: 我对父母说谢谢。
questions.explanation: 蛋糕是妈妈做的，礼物是父母和朋友送的，此处对父母说谢谢，故选parents。

questions.translation: 我们在生日派对上玩得很开心。
questions.explanation: have a good time意为“过得愉快、玩得开心”。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Every year, October 16 is a happy day for Jane because it's her birthday. Today is October 16. Jane is eight years old. She gets up early and then goes to the front door. She finds some birthday cards there. Today she gets ten beautiful cards. Some of them are from her friends, and some are from her cousins. Her parents give her a yellow watch. She likes it very much.

Jane has a birthday party in the garden. There is a big table in the garden. A birthday cake with eight candles is on the table. Some presents are on the table, too. They are all about baseballs. There is an orange baseball hat from Ben, a white baseball bat from Judy, a baseball card from Tom and some baseballs from Sam. Jane really loves baseballs! It's her favourite sport. She often plays it with her classmates after class.

Today, Jane is very happy. It is a great day.

questions.translation: 简多大了？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Today is October 16. Jane is eight years old.”可知简8岁了。

questions.prompt: 17. The underlined word "it" in Paragraph 2 refers to
questions.translation: 第二段中画线词“it”指代的是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Her parents give her a yellow watch. She likes it very much.”可知it指代这块手表。

questions.prompt:
18. What presents does Jane get?
①Some beautiful cards.
②A yellow watch.
③An orange baseball bat.
④A white baseball hat.
⑤Some basketballs.
questions.translation: 简收到了什么礼物？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“ten beautiful cards”, “a yellow watch”以及第二段“an orange baseball hat”, “a white baseball bat”可知，卡片、手表、棒球帽正确，棒球棍是白色的（③错误），故①②④正确。

questions.prompt: 19. What can we learn from the text?
questions.translation: 我们能从文中了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Today is October 16. Jane is eight years old.”及“Every year, October 16 is a happy day for Jane because it's her birthday.”可知今天是个特殊的日子——简的生日。

questions.prompt: 20. What kind of writing is the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章是什么文体？
questions.explanation: 文章讲述了简过生日的故事，属于记叙文/故事。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
①We all want to have great parties on our birthdays. It's not easy to have a great party. How do we have a great party? Let me tell you.

②We need to have it on the right day. If your friends or classmates are busy on that day, some of them will not come to your party. Saturday and Sunday are good days for a party because students don't go to school. You can have your party on Saturday afternoon. It's OK to have it on Sunday afternoon too.

③You need to invite your friends and classmates to your party. Tell them when and where you have the party. If you have the party on Saturday, you need to tell them on Thursday. Then they can have time to prepare a present for you.

④Think about games for the party. Your friends and classmates like playing games at the party. You need to think about proper (合适的) games. The games need to be easy and interesting for your friends and classmates. Then you can have a good time at the party.

questions.translation: 在什么时候办派对比较好？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Saturday and Sunday are good days for a party”可知周末办派对很好。

questions.prompt: 22. You need to tell your friends and classmates **[blank]** before the party, so they can have time to prepare a present.
questions.translation: 你需要在派对前几天告诉你的朋友和同学，以便他们有时间准备礼物？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“If you have the party on Saturday, you need to tell them on Thursday.”周四到周六相差两天。

questions.prompt: 23. What does the last paragraph talk about?
questions.translation: 最后一段讨论了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段首句“Think about games for the party.”可知最后一段讲的是派对上的游戏。

questions.prompt: 24. What is the structure of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的结构是什么？
questions.explanation: 第一段总起提出如何举办好派对，第2、3、4段分别从选择正确的时间、邀请朋友以及准备游戏三个方面进行分述，属于总分结构（1为总，2、3、4为并列分述）。

questions.prompt: 25. What is the main purpose of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主要目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“How do we have a great party? Let me tell you.”可知文章主要告诉我们如何举办一个棒极了的派对。
options: To tell us how to buy presents.
To tell us the date to have a party.
To tell us how to have a great party.
To let us buy presents for friends' birthdays.

sections.title: 四、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容,将下面的选项还原到文中空白处,使短文内容完整、通顺, 每个选项只能用一次,其中有一个选项是多余的。
sections.passage:
Children around the world like to celebrate their birthdays. Now, many Chinese children usually celebrate their birthdays with a party. [26] They often have a good time together. However, they may not have the party on the date of the birthday if it comes on a school day. [27] Chinese children can have the party in different places. Some may have it at home. [28] Wherever(无论哪儿) they have the party, they always eat a kind of special food-long noodles. Children sing songs for the birthday child. [29] One candle stands for(代表) one year old. Everyone sings the "Happy Birthday" song. The birthday child will make a wish, and then blow out the candles.

As children grow older, their birthday parties change. Some people stop having them. [30] But they'd like to remember the happy birthday parties of their childhood (童年).
wordbank: A. Some may have it in a restaurant.
B. They may have it on the closest (最近的) weekend.
C. There is usually a birthday cake with candles on it.
D. What do you usually do on your birthday?
E. They say they want to forget how old they are.
F. They ask some of their friends to come to the party.

questions.translation: 孩子们在世界各地喜欢庆祝生日。现在许多中国孩子通常办派对庆祝。他们邀请一些朋友来参加派对。
questions.explanation: 上文提到许多中国孩子举行派对庆祝生日，空格后说“They often have a good time together”，选项F“他们邀请一些朋友来参加派对”符合语境。
questions.answer: F. They ask some of their friends to come to the party.

questions.translation: 然而，如果生日恰逢上学日，他们可能不会在生日当天举行派对。他们可能会在最近的周末举行。
questions.explanation: 前面提到“if it comes on a school day”无法在当天过生日，因此选项B“他们可能会在最近的周末举行”承接上文。
questions.answer: B. They may have it on the closest (最近的) weekend.

questions.translation: 中国孩子可以在不同的地方举行派对。有些人可能在家里举行。有些人可能在餐馆里举行。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“Some may have it at home”，选项A“Some may have it in a restaurant”与前句构成并列结构。
questions.answer: A. Some may have it in a restaurant.

questions.translation: 孩子们为寿星唱歌。通常上面有蜡烛的生日蛋糕摆在那里。一根蜡烛代表一岁。
questions.explanation: 后文提到“One candle stands for one year old”，可见空格处与蜡烛、蛋糕有关，选项C“通常上面有蜡烛的生日蛋糕摆在那里”符合语境。
questions.answer: C. There is usually a birthday cake with candles on it.

questions.translation: 随着孩子们长大，他们的生日派对变了。有些人不再举行派对。但是他们愿意记住童年快乐的生日派对。
questions.explanation: 上文提到有些人不办派对，选项E“They say they want to forget how old they are.”或转折句“But they'd like to remember...”前后对比，此处选E或者其他？等等，仔细看上下文：“Some people stop having them. [30] But they'd like to remember...” 选项E“They say they want to forget how old they are”或者别的，核对备选项：选项E为合适选项。
questions.answer: E. They say they want to forget how old they are.
